description: I am honest with me and that allows me to be honest with the external world. #accountability #selfpresservation #selfmastery
transcript: I give myself the most raw, real version of me to me. There has been times during my journey where I would censor different sides and different experiences, trying to hide them from my internal world out of fear of judging myself. The relationship I have with myself is the most important, and that deserves honesty, it deserves transparency, it deserves realness. If I am not real with myself, I can't be my fullest self for the external world.
